level_one.title: Borean Winds
level_one.description: After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.  Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

level_four.title: Shattered Armor
level_four.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Icebound Fortitude
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.  Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Army of the Dead
level_ten.description: Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.  Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Deathchill
level_thirteen.description: Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers.  Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.

level_sixteen.title: Remorseless Winter
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

level_twenty.title: Legion of Northrend
level_twenty.description: Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.  Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

level_one.title: Pity the Frail
level_one.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

level_four.title: Martyrdom
level_four.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

level_seven.title: Intercession
level_seven.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

level_ten.title: Scarlet Aegis
level_ten.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Subjugation
level_thirteen.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

level_sixteen.title: Shared Punishment
level_sixteen.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

level_twenty.title: Scarlet Crusade
level_twenty.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Sentinel Wisp
level_one.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

level_four.title: Nature's Culling
level_four.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

level_seven.title: Splintered Spear
level_seven.description: Casting Noxious Blossom grants Lunara 3 stacks of Splintered Spear. When Lunara uses her Basic Attack, it hits an additional enemy for each stack of Splintered Spear, consuming 1 stack for each target. Stores up to 3 stacks.  Splintered Spear deals 90 (+4% per level) damage, and applies Nature's Toxin.

level_ten.title: Leaping Strike
level_ten.description: Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Let Them Wither
level_thirteen.description: Increases Crippling Spores' Slow duration by 1 second and causes it to no longer decay.

level_sixteen.title: Unfair Advantage
level_sixteen.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

level_twenty.title: Intensifying Toxin
level_twenty.description: At 3 stacks, Nature's Toxin deals 40% more damage.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: In the Rhythm
level_four.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

level_seven.title: Relentless Soldier
level_seven.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

level_ten.title: Drakken Laser Drill
level_ten.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spray 'n' Pray
level_thirteen.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

level_sixteen.title: Sizzlin' Attacks
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

level_twenty.title: Focusing Diodes
level_twenty.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%. Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% additional damage.

level_one.title: Furious Blow
level_one.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

level_four.title: Shot Of Fury
level_four.description: Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

level_seven.title: Poisoned Spear
level_seven.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

level_ten.title: Leap
level_ten.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Mystical Spear
level_thirteen.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Rampage
level_sixteen.description: Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Ignore Pain
level_twenty.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.

level_one.title: Unrelenting Torment
level_one.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Festering Wounds
level_seven.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level_ten.title: Wailing Arrow
level_ten.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

level_thirteen.title: Windrunner
level_thirteen.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 4 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

level_sixteen.title: Life Drain
level_sixteen.description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sylvanas to enemies with 3 stacks of Black Arrows. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

level_one.title: Warbreaker
level_one.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Indomitable
level_four.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Intimidation
level_seven.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Warlord's Challenge
level_ten.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Defensive Measures
level_thirteen.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Seasoned Soldier
level_sixteen.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

level_one.title: Moonlit Arrows
level_one.description: Basic Attacks decrease the cooldown of Light of Elune by an additional 0.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Mark of Mending
level_four.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against Marked targets heal other allied Heroes near the enemy for 4% of their maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Kaldorei Resistance
level_seven.description: Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

level_ten.title: Starfall
level_ten.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ranger's Mark
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hunter's Mark by 2 second. Basic Attacks against marked targets reduce the cooldown of Lunar Flare by 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Attunement
level_sixteen.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Eternal Retaliation
level_four.description: Mark enemies hit by Condemn for 10 seconds. Johanna's next Basic Attack against them removes the mark, lowering the cooldown of Condemn by 1 second, refunding 10 Mana, and killing Minions.

level_seven.title: Sins Exposed
level_seven.description: Punish reduces healing received by 35% for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them refresh this duration.

level_ten.title: Falling Sword
level_ten.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Blessed Hammer
level_thirteen.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Renewal
level_sixteen.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

level_one.title: Simple Geometry
level_one.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

level_four.title: Serrated Arrows
level_four.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_seven.title: Never Outmatched
level_seven.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Dragonstrike
level_ten.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

level_thirteen.title: Mounted Archery
level_thirteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Summon Mount by 2 seconds. Upon mounting, gain 25% additional Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Using Natural Agility instantly mounts.

level_sixteen.title: Piercing Arrows
level_sixteen.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.
